name: smwmusic-link-the-faces-of-evil-do-the-duck-walk-firestone-lake-remix
title: Link: The Faces Of Evil - DO THE DUCK WALK!! ~ Firestone Lake (Remix)
description:
❝ 𝑀𝒶𝒽 𝒷𝑜𝒾, 𝓉𝒽𝒾𝓈 𝓅𝑒𝒶𝒸𝑒 𝒾𝓈 𝓌𝒽𝒶𝓉 𝒶𝓁𝓁 𝓉𝓇𝓊𝑒 𝓌𝒶𝓇𝓇𝒾𝑜𝓇𝓈 𝓈𝓉𝓇𝒾𝓋𝑒 𝐹𝒪𝑅! ❞
‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎ㅤ- King Harkinian, 1993

Yes, you're not seeing things. I just did an actual SNES arrangement of Firestone Lake from Link: The Faces of Evil. I dunno if y'all know about this... but I'm UNIRONICALLY in love with the first two Zelda CD-I OSTs. I'm not kidding when I say this is some of my favorite Zelda music ever. Look, other old-school Zelda OSTs are good too, but William Havlicek just said "fuggit!" and gave us high-energy music. This doesn't sound like Zelda in the slightest, but who cares! I like it, and you will too!!!

Also, this is my first Zelda arrangement / port, and it had to be from this game, lmao.

Important:
‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎ㅤ♠ "Bonus End," P-Switch, & Thunder SFX are disabled.

There are also customizable pitches for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎ㅤ1. C / F Minor (Original Pitch) [turned on by default]
‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎ㅤ2. C# / F# Minor (Ricky Martin Pitch)
‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎ㅤ3. A / D Minor (Shrek 2 Pitch)
